events.title: Tribute: Freddie Mercury would have been 80

angles.name: Freddie Tribute

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'

angles.copy: Take a trip back to '65 – The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' on this day, an album that truly changed the game. Still sounds fresh today.
